messages:
Kofi: Quick spike idea: surface per-tenant 'notify budget' in the SLO editor and let teams pick fallback routing (digest|escalate|always).
Elena: Love it. We should call it `fanout_policy` in the API to avoid confusion with quota.
Tariq: Implementation note: runtime checks budget before fanout. If insufficient and policy=digest -> create condensed payload. If policy=escalate -> escalate to secondary on-call immediately.
Nina: UX: preview button that runs `POST /api/v1/notify-preview` and returns `mode`, `would_notify` list, and `budget_remaining`. Preview must match runtime.
Kofi: Example preview payload: `{"slo_id":"slo-999","policy":"digest","timestamp":3300000000}` -> response includes `{"mode":"condensed","recipients":[],"budget_remaining":45}`.
Elena: Telemetry: emit `slo.notify.mode` (immediate/condensed/escalate/blocked) and `slo.notify.budget_remaining`. Labels: tenant_id, slo_id, policy. Sample 100% for first 48h.
Tariq: Rollout plan: feature-gate the UI + API for 2% tenants. Run 48h job sampling `slo.notify.effective_count` and `slo.alert.time_to_ack`. Abort if time_to_ack increases >25% for any prod tenant.
Nina: Safety rules: always immediate if severity==P0 or signal `slo.impact.severity_score` > 0.9. Also add per-tenant manual opt-out from condensed mode.
Kofi: Quotas: default budget 300 tokens/hour. token cost: immediate=1, condensed=10 (for digest payload). Make configurable per-tenant.
Elena: API compatibility: new fields optional, default behaviour = immediate/shared. Add migration note in openapi.
Tariq: Tests: unit for budget accounting, integration for preview endpoint contract, e2e scenario that fires 500 alerts to confirm digest coalescing and links remain actionable.
rollout-bot: rollout started: fanout-policies-v1 -> 2% (ok).
Nina: Ops alert: if `slo.notify.mode == condensed` for >15% tenants >20m, page oncall. We don't want widespread silent condensing.
Kofi: I'll open a PR for API + UI copy. Can someone own the telemetry dashboards?
Elena: I'll add dashboards: a per-tenant panel for `effective_count`, `budget_remaining`, `mode_breakdown`.
Tariq: I'll add preview contract tests and the runtime guard.
Kofi: Great. Quick sync tomorrow 9:30 to review metrics dump. :thumbsup:
